question: India's first national academy for music, dance and drama was:

options.text: The Academy for Arts and Dance

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi** was established in 1953 as India's first national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• The Akademi was set up to promote and preserve the traditional and classical arts of India.
 
• It organizes various performances, festivals, and workshops to encourage artists and spread awareness of Indian cultural heritage.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi also confers awards and fellowships to eminent artists in the field of performing arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Culture** plays a significant role in the functioning and funding of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• The Akademi has regional centers across India to cater to the diverse cultural needs of different regions.
 
• In addition to organizing events, the Akademi also undertakes research and documentation projects to preserve the rich cultural traditions of India.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi has a library and archives that house a vast collection of books, manuscripts, and recordings related to Indian performing arts.
 
• It also collaborates with international cultural organizations to promote Indian arts globally.
